_comment: Shipped preset for TripoSplat image-to-gaussian-splat, adapted from ComfyUI's official 3d_triposplat_image_to_gaussian_splat template. Flattened from the official subgraph: background removal is always on (LoadImage #1 -> RemoveBackground #3 -> TripoSplatPreprocessImage #4), the switch/preview/orbit-video/mesh-export branches are dropped. Chain continues TripoSplatConditioning #8 -> KSampler #9 (20 steps / cfg 3 / dpmpp_2m-simple) -> VAEDecodeTripoSplat #11 (262144 gaussians) -> SplatToFile3D #12 (spz) -> SaveGLB #13. The decode seed stays fixed at 0 (it only seeds the deterministic octree sampler); the KSampler seed is randomized per Run.
label: TripoSplat Gaussian
description: TripoSplat image-to-3D Gaussian Splat. Takes one upstream image (background is auto-removed via BiRefNet), outputs an .spz splat file. Requires triposplat_fp16 + dino_v3_vit_h + both TripoSplat VAEs + birefnet — see workflows/model/README.md. Optional custom params: seed, steps (20), guidance (3), num_gaussians (262144).

image.error: TripoSplat needs an upstream image — wire one into this stage's images slot.
